description: This file defines the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter class, which manages user prompts and decision-making for execution approval requests within the OpenClaw application. It handles stream subscriptions, decoding requests, applying security policies, and presenting prompts or automatic decisions based on various conditions.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter
classes.description: Singleton class that manages execution approval prompts and decisions based on incoming events and security policies.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the polling stream to listen for approval requests.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an incoming push event, decodes the approval request, and determines whether to prompt the user or auto-approve/deny based on policy.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Evaluates whether the approval request should be presented to the user considering the current connection mode, session activity, and last input time.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the approval request stream subscription.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Terminates the subscription to the approval request stream.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the main loop to listen for incoming approval push events.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles an individual push event, decoding and responding with prompt or decision.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Determines if the approval request should be prompted to the user.

methods.name: fallbackDecision
methods.description: Provides a fallback approval decision based on pre-defined fallback policies.

methods.name: fallbackResolution
methods.description: Resolves the command executable name from the request for allowlist matching.

methods.name: firstToken
methods.description: Extracts the first token (executable name) from a command string.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Determines if the request should be presented considering session, mode, and input activity.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the seconds since the last user input event.
